title: Uber carried 63% of trips to and from JFK and LaGuardia and to Newark in Sep 2026

subtitles.split: In Sep 2026, Uber led pickups at JFK (53%) and LaGuardia (59%)
subtitles.share_trend: Yellow cabs' share of trips fell 3.2 pts at JFK and 0.8 pts at LaGuardia between Sep 2025 and Sep 2026
subtitles.by_hour: Airport trips peaked at 3 pm, with 4,460 trips in that hour on an average day over the 3 months to Sep 2026
subtitles.fares: Mean fares to Manhattan before tip in Sep 2026 ran from $84 by yellow cabs to $127 by Uber for trips from JFK, and from $65.09 by yellow cabs to $87.33 by Uber for trips from LaGuardia
